title: ervatamia pubescens var. punctulata
intro: Ervatamia pubescens var. punctulata, commonly known as Thai jasmine or Thai star jasmine, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Thai medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. Ervatamia pubescens var. punctulata is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
